in_arabic.name: عطاوة
in_arabic.meaning: المُصطَلح من العِطاء و التَوَه، المُنعم بِالرِزق و التوفيق

This name has been used in Islamic tradition and is associated with the Arabic root word Attai and Tahah. It is a name that reflects the blessings and favors bestowed by Allah upon His servants. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the concept of divine favor and benevolence, and is considered a name that is pleasing to Allah.
